name: Tooltip
summary: Provides delayed descriptive text for a trigger.

useWhen: Adding concise help to an interactive control
avoidWhen: Communicating essential instructions only through hover

obligations: Open from keyboard focus as well as pointer hover.
Expose tooltip semantics and link it to its trigger.

behavior: Delegate hover and focus timing, global one-tooltip sequencing, Escape handling, portal mounting, and teardown to RAC TooltipTrigger.
Require descriptive content and a focusable trigger while preserving Core's 500 ms open and zero-delay close defaults.
accessibility: Set aria-describedby on the trigger while visible.
Expose role tooltip and retain keyboard focus on the trigger.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
